title: The Lift Has A Thirteenth Floor (Part 1) #shorts #horror
description: A CreepyCartoonTales story from Creepyville. What would you do? Tell us in the comments.
lines: Imagine you just moved into a new building in Creepyville. Twelve floors. You checked.
You're so tired after moving boxes all day, you can barely stand.
You step into the lift and press twelve.
The doors close. The lights flicker.
And next to the twelve, there's a new button.
You blink. It's still there. Glowing. Warm, like someone just pressed it.
You don't press it. You're not stupid.
The lift stops at twelve. You go home and lock the door.
The next night, it's there again.
And this time, the lift doesn't stop at twelve.
The doors open onto a hallway that looks exactly like yours.
Same carpet. Same plant. Same door at the end. Your door.
It's open. The lights are on.
And from inside, you hear yourself laughing at the TV.
*Then your own voice calls out: "Is someone there? Close the door, it's cold."
Part two is coming next. Follow, so you don't miss it.
